name: IndiaMART Seller

sources.title: Sell on IndiaMART — 'Free Registration on India's Largest Online Marketplace' (homepage blocked to fetchers, confirmed via search result)
IndiaMART help: create a free seller account — mobile OTP, company details, min 3 products, up to 7 days for free listing to appear (content read via search result)
IndiaMART help: registration is free; paid subscription services exist for better listing and added benefits (content read via search result)

conditions: Free seller registration exists but requires a mobile number (OTP-verified), Indian business details, and a catalog of at least 3 products
This is a B2B product-goods marketplace — a pure SaaS product does not fit the catalog model
requirements: 10-digit mobile number for OTP verification (Indian business context)
Company name, email, city/PIN, business address; GST number is optional but expected
Minimum 3 products with images to complete registration
Free listings can take up to 7 days to appear
Paid subscription tiers ('Paid Services') provide better listing placement and more inquiries
preparation: Indian business details: company name, GST number (optional), address, PIN code
Mobile number able to receive OTP
At least 3 product listings with images — physical goods/B2B catalog items
workflow: Open seller.indiamart.com and click 'Create Free Seller Account'
Enter mobile number and verify with OTP
Fill basic details: name, company name, email, city, PIN, GST (optional)
Add at least 3 products to the catalog
Enter business address and click 'Start Selling'
Free listing goes live within ~7 days in the IndiaMART directory
watchFor: India-centric — the OTP flow expects an Indian mobile number and business address; a foreign SaaS is a poor fit
Free tier exists but IndiaMART heavily upsells 'Paid Services' subscriptions
seller.indiamart.com blocked automated fetch (403) — details verified via IndiaMART help-center pages
Registration requires review before the listing appears
countsAsLive: The company profile and product catalog appear publicly on indiamart.com (searchable supplier storefront)
unknowns: Whether non-Indian businesses can register at all
Paid plan pricing — only accessible inside the seller dashboard
